description: FastAPI router module for managing notes, including endpoints for listing, creating, retrieving, updating, and deleting notes.

classes.name: APIRouter
classes.description: FastAPI router object used to define API endpoints.

methods.name: list_all_notes
methods.description: Handles GET requests to list all stored notes.

methods.name: create_new_note
methods.description: Handles POST requests to create a new note.

methods.name: retrieve_note
methods.description: Handles GET requests to retrieve a specific note by ID.

methods.name: update_existing_note
methods.description: Handles PUT requests to update an existing note by ID.

methods.name: delete_existing_note
methods.description: Handles DELETE requests to remove a note by ID.
